title: Sacerdotal
summary: SACERDO'TAL, adjective [Latin sacerdotalis, from sacerdos, a priest. See Sacred.] Pertaining to priests or the priesthood; priestly; as sacerdotal dignity; sacerdotal functions or garments; sacerdotal

inlines.v: SACERDO'TAL, adjective [Latin sacerdotalis, from sacerdos, a priest. See Sacred.] Pertaining to priests or the priesthood; priestly; as sacerdotal dignity; sacerdotal functions or garments; sacerdotal character.
